parts.text: 7 This question is about acids, bases and salts.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Crystals of potassium chloride can be made by reacting an acid with an alkali.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Choose from the list the type of reaction that takes place when an acid reacts with an alkali. Draw a circle around your chosen answer. addition neutralisation redox substitution [1]

ms.label: 7(a)(iv)
ms.text:
one mark each for any two of:
•
evaporate some of the water / heat to the point of crystallisation / heat until crystals seen
•
filter off crystals / pick out crystals
•
dry crystals with filter paper

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Crystals of potassium chloride dissolve in water. This process is endothermic.
